SHARED-FLIGHT configs: SFO/SMF\u2192ICN.summary: All four shared-plane configurations verified as real routes. (1) KE024 SFO-ICN nonstop: employee economy ~$650-900 one-way (aggregator $795), and KE NOW SELLS premium economy ('Premium Class', ~110% of economy, launched Sept 2025 on 11 retrofitted 777-300ERs) — but it is aircraft-assignment dependent on SFO, so check the specific Sept 27 tail. (2) UA nonstop: Polaris ~$2,700-4,400 + economy ~$473-600 is the cheapest combined config (~$4,700 total for 1J+3Y) but earns zero SkyTeam credit. (3) DL SMF-SEA-ICN (A350-900, 32 D1 Suites, verified daily): Delta One ~$2,400-4,500 + Main ~$600-850; best for Diamond earn and departs SMF. (4) KE643 ICN-SIN (777-300ER, new Prestige, daily 13:50): Prestige corroborated at $1,000-1,600 (your $1,000 is the floor) and economy $300-480 (your $280 is optimistic — October is a peak month on this route). (5) Joint ticketing WINS for the employees on cash: a KE multi-city SFO-ICN + stopover + ICN-SIN + SIN-ICN-SFO circle trip prices from RT-fare halves instead of three one-way premiums — expect ~10-25% savings (~$1,400-1,650 vs ~$1,795 in separate one-ways) plus full irrops protection; the advantage does NOT exist on SkyPass awards (now priced segment-by-segment). (6) Mixed-cabin mechanics differ by carrier: KOREAN AIR does not support different cabins per passenger in one online booking — book Jarred's Prestige and the employees' economy as two PNRs on the same flights and have KE's service center cross-reference them (TCP/OSI), or ticket by phone; DELTA's website also prices the whole party in one cabin, but a phone agent CAN build a mixed-cabin party reservation (reports indicate up to 9 pax across classes, cash+award mixable), or book all 4 in Main on one PNR and buy Jarred's Delta One upgrade from the seat map. Same-PNR or agent-linked PNRs materially help: the party is rebooked together during irregular ops and seat assignments are managed as one group.
SHARED-FLIGHT configs: SFO/SMF\u2192ICN.caveats: No prices here are live quotes — Sept 27 / Oct 4 2026 inventory was not directly loaded (Kayak/Expedia/Google Flights block automated fetches), so everything is labeled aggregator-estimate or historical-typical; run the exact dates on koreanair.com, delta.com, united.com before deciding. KE643 Prestige at ~$1,000 is the optimistic floor; budget $1,200-1,600. October is cited as one of the most expensive months for ICN-SIN economy, so the $280 employee estimate should be revised to ~$350. Delta 'mixed classes on one reservation' capability comes from a secondary travel-industry source (MightyTravels) — confirm with the Delta Diamond line when booking; the bulletproof fallback on both carriers is two PNRs (1 biz, 1 econ x3) linked by the airline. Closest on time: SQ28 SIN-SEA nonstop (09:00 -> 08:45 same day, Sat+Sun both operate) + Alaska hop, ~20.1h (+2.3h, passes time) but ~$941+ (+~$300, fails price), no Delta earning.
